record.explanation: The Ministry's May 2018 release explicitly expands AYUSH as Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy. Broader later system coverage does not change this historical acronym expansion. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed.
